Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Atlanta, City Council defeats attempt to repeal a gay rights clause in city's Bill of Rights 2. Voting underway to change federal prohibitions on rape to be defined as sexual assault on another person, regardless of sex or age, and including spouse-on-spouse assault 3. $111,000 from a benefactor's will to go to Lambda legal defense and education and the Human Rights Fund COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser, with John Glines 4. Trikone organized for gay and lesbians of South Asian decent 5. Andy Humm on 1986 Maryland senate race COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 6. World Health Organization announces significant increase in AIDS cases 7. California governor George Deukmejian vetoes anti-discrimination bill for people with AIDS 8. Potential vaccine for AIDS enters period of animal testing 9. AIDS treatment involving ozone applies to begin human trials COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 10. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: GCN pledge drive, with clips from the year's news 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Announcement of death from AIDS of Michael Rock, co-creator of "Rockshots" erotic greeting cards, with clips from Playboy TV feature COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation with Jose Sarria 3. Interview with Denise Harbin about the TIPPS advertising guide to creative resources in New York City COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser, with John Glines 4. David Summers' birthday party with Broadway guests and performances 5. Unnamed man at The Advocate's "man search" party does a striptease 6. Closing credits
